projects.name: Interactive macOS & iOS Web Ecosystem Portfolio
projects.architecture: React 18, Framer Motion, react-rnd, Tailwind CSS, Web Battery API
highlights: Architected an adaptive dual-environment portfolio seamlessly transitioning between a full desktop macOS experience and an interactive iPhone hardware enclosure based on viewport size.
Engineered a macOS window manager with draggable, resizable, and focus-layered windows using react-rnd, alongside spring-physics Dock magnification.
Built native iOS hardware interactions including functional Dynamic Island controls, side physical buttons, lock screen workflows, and real-time system power status via navigator.getBattery().
Designed custom desktop widgets (Weather, Calendar, Notes) and glassmorphic UI components with Apple boot-up sequence animations.

projects.name: Smart AI Restaurant Assistant (Kolkata Kitchen)
highlights: Architected a full-stack AI-powered dining assistant for Bengali cuisine and meal discovery using Google Gemini API.
Engineered dynamic meal-time context detection (Breakfast, Lunch, Dinner & Evening Adda) to suggest localized daily specials.
Designed a dark-mode Bento & Glassmorphism UI with real-time Markdown rendering via react-markdown.
Deployed decoupled architecture with frontend on Vercel CDN and Node backend service on Render.

projects.name: InterviewX | AI-Powered Mock Interview Platform
projects.architecture: MERN Stack, Firebase, Razorpay, OpenRouter API (GPT-4o Mini)

Implemented secure user authentication with JWT and Firebase Google Sign-In.
Developed RESTful APIs for interview session management and AI-generated performance reports.
Integrated Razorpay payment gateway for token-based interview access.

projects.name: Real-Time Chat Application
